SELECT cm.id, cm.article_id, a.title AS article_title, cm.parent_id, cm.reply_to_id, cm.nickname, cm.email, cm.content, cm.status, cm.create_time, cm.update_time FROM tb_comment cm LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON cm.article_id = a.id
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{articleTitle}, '%')
AND cm.status = #{status}
ORDER BY cm.id DESC

SELECT cm.id, cm.article_id, a.title AS article_title, cm.parent_id, cm.reply_to_id, cm.nickname, cm.email, cm.content, cm.status, cm.create_time, cm.update_time FROM tb_comment cm LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON cm.article_id = a.id WHERE cm.id = #{id}
